concepts.title: A / KIRIN MK.II
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium concept-design sheet for ONIZUKA AERO AGI Co.'s fictional collectible toy aircraft, intended as a visual reference for a CAD model and an arcade game.
Primary request: make a dramatically cooler original near-future fighter-looking TOY. This is imaginative toy styling, not a real aircraft design.
Style/medium: sophisticated Japanese science-fiction industrial-design concept art, polished hard-surface 3D product render, crisp readable forms, strong silhouette, high-quality materials, controlled detail. A few large interlocking surfaces that can be modeled in CAD, with accent panels and toy-like seams, not a noisy pile of greebles.
Composition: landscape concept sheet. One large complete three-quarter hero view occupying most of the page, with a smaller clear top view and side view of the SAME consistent design along the bottom. Entire aircraft and wing tips visible, nose pointed to the left in the hero view, no cropping. Clean neutral light-gray studio background, soft grounding shadow, no environment or props.
Constraints: original fictional design, unmistakably a collectible plastic desk toy; harmless rounded edge treatment underneath the sharp visual styling. No weapons, missiles, gun barrels, bomb bays, ammunition, military insignia, real manufacturer logos, schematics, dimensions or engineering specifications. No characters. No watermark. Only the exact small title specified below; no other text. The smaller views must match the hero silhouette and colors. This sheet is conceptual artwork, not a CAD or simulation result.
Subject and visual direction: A — the elegant spearhead evolution of AX-01 KIRIN. A long sculpted central nose with a dark smoked teal canopy nested into it, broad cranked swept wings forming a clean arrowhead silhouette, two small outward-canted jewel-like fins at the rear, strongly layered dorsal armor panels, restrained cyan light strips and an orange identification accent. Pearl white main surfaces, deep midnight-blue secondary panels, cyan glass. Sleek and fast-looking yet solid and tactile, rather than flat paper wings. Clearly a striking premium Japanese sci-fi model-kit toy.
Text (verbatim): "A / KIRIN MK.II", set once in small clean sans-serif typography.
